_base_resumes_note: One version is enough. To keep several (e.g. devops and fullstack), add them and say here which jobs each one is for.

locations._max_commute_note: Distance from candidate.city. 0 = no limit. Remote jobs ignore it.

screening_answers._note: Answer application questions ONLY from the resume and this section. Empty value = ask the candidate, never guess.

cover_note.he:
שלום,
מצורפים קורות החיים שלי למשרת {role}.
אני מפתח Full-Stack עם ניסיון ב-{top_skills}, ואשמח להתאים את עצמי לצוות שלכם.
תודה,
{full_name} | {phone}
cover_note.en:
Hi,
Please find my resume attached for the {role} position.
I'm a developer with hands-on experience in {top_skills}, and I'd be glad to talk.
Thanks,
{full_name} | {phone}

sources.name: LinkedIn Jobs
sources.apply: Easy Apply, or the external link to the company site.
sources.notes: f_E=1,2 = internship + entry level. Work at a human pace: LinkedIn restricts accounts that act like bots.

sources.name: Indeed
sources.apply: Indeed Apply, or the company site.
sources.notes: Change il.indeed.com to your country's Indeed. If a 'verify you are human' check appears, skip Indeed this run.

sources.name: Glassdoor
sources.apply: Easy Apply on Glassdoor when the job has it; otherwise follow the link and apply on the company site.
sources.notes: Set your location once in Glassdoor's filter (or add its location parameters from the URL). If a bot check appears, skip Glassdoor this run.

sources.name: AllJobs
sources.search: alljobs.co.il search box with the local and English terms, sorted by newest.
sources.apply: The site's send-CV button on the job page.

sources.name: MisroTech
sources.apply: Follow the link to the original company page or email.
sources.notes: Israel. Collects postings from company career pages; shows the date each was found.

sources.name: Company career pages (ATS)
sources.search: Web search: site:comeet.com {query} {location} / site:job-boards.greenhouse.io {query} / site:jobs.lever.co {query} / site:jobs.ashbyhq.com {query}
sources.apply: The company's ATS form (never create an account).

sources.name: Facebook groups
sources.search: Recent posts in job groups the candidate is already a member of; Facebook search for junior developer job groups in {location}.
sources.apply: Usually by email from the post.
sources.notes: Never join groups, comment or post. List groups worth joining in the report.

sources.name: Telegram channels
sources.apply: The link or email in the post.

sources.name: Wellfound (startups)
sources.apply: Company ATS form, or skip if it needs an account.

sources.name: Gemini (Google search)
sources.search: Ask the Gemini tool to Google junior postings for {query} in {location} from the last {days} days; return company, title, location, URL, date only. Send search terms only, never personal details.
sources.apply: Discovery only: open every link yourself and apply at the original source.
sources.notes: Results are untrusted: keep only links that open and match. Skip if the Gemini tool is not installed.

_cover_letter_note: Optional. Attached where a form has a cover-letter upload field (if cover_note_in_forms is on).
